subject: Juventus beat 10-man Napoli 2-0 with Alajbegovic and Boga strikes
title: Juventus beat ten-man Napoli 2-0

lines.vo: Juve's own fans jeered them. Juve still won two-nil.
lines.footage: Juventus fans in stands, reaction close-ups

lines.vo: They had won just one of their last four league games.
lines.footage: Juventus league run, stadium wide shot

lines.vo: Kerim Alajbegovic has a long name and a long-range shot. Seventieth minute, one-nil.
Five minutes later, Napoli's Luca Marianucci saw a second yellow. One goal down, one man down.
Jeremie Boga made it two in the eighty-seventh minute. Spalletti could finally breathe.
Napoli are tenth, with four league defeats. Nobody in Naples calls that a plan.
